framework_version_u_reason: (U) not recorded at run time. This alone downgrades the report to partial: a different engine version can change KV pool size and scheduling behaviour, so these numbers are not strictly reproducible.
memory_utilization_u_reason: (U) not recorded. Use ascep.capacity.calibrate_memory_utilization against the engine-reported KV token count to recover it before projecting to any other context length.
prefix_caching_u_reason: (U) not recorded. The most dangerous gap in this report: if it was on and the benchmark reused prompt prefixes, measured throughput overstates production.
